definition: 12-1 price momentum: close[m-1]/close[m-13]-1 (skips the most recent month)
note: kept from Phase 7-C; classic cross-sectional momentum
NEW horizon diversification of the momentum bucket

definition: risk-adjusted 12-1 momentum: (12-1 return) / trailing 12-month monthly-return stdev
note: NEW; rewards steady trends over volatile ones

definition: annual diluted EPS / price (E/P); higher = cheaper = better
note: kept from Phase 7-C; residual split-basis caveat (see docs)

definition: annual revenue / (implied diluted shares * price); higher = cheaper
note: NEW; sales-to-price using implied shares NI/EPS

definition: annual free cash flow / (implied diluted shares * price); higher = cheaper
note: NEW; cash-flow value, robust to accrual accounting

definition: latest shareholder equity / (implied diluted shares * price); higher = cheaper
note: NEW; book-to-price using the most-recent quarterly equity

definition: return on equity = annual net income / latest shareholder equity
return on assets = annual net income / latest total assets (asset efficiency)
net margin = annual net income / annual revenue
operating margin = annual operating income / annual revenue
free-cash-flow margin = annual free cash flow / annual revenue
asset turnover = annual revenue / latest total assets
negative balance-sheet accruals = -((net income - operating cash flow) / total assets); lower accruals = higher earnings quality (sign inverted a priori)
note: NEW earnings-quality / accruals measure; cash earnings preferred

definition: revenue YoY = latest annual revenue / prior annual revenue - 1
earnings YoY = latest annual net income / prior annual net income - 1 (prior > 0 only)
note: NEW; guarded against negative-base sign distortion

definition: free-cash-flow YoY = latest annual FCF / prior annual FCF - 1 (prior > 0 only)

note: a-priori RISK DESCRIPTOR: low-vol is a risk characteristic, not an alpha factor; reported for evidence but excluded from the alpha composite

definition: TTM earnings yield = TTM net income / (implied shares * price); TTM built by annual+interim roll-forward from clean 3-month quarterly frames
note: NEW TTM attempt; included only if local clean-quarterly coverage clears approval
